title: Tooltip
description: A short text label shown when the user hovers over or focuses an element. Near the viewport edges it flips and shifts to stay visible.

props.name: content
props.description: Content displayed inside the tooltip

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the tooltip is shown (controlled; pair with onOpenChange)

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state (uncontrolled)

props.name: placement
props.description: Placement relative to the trigger

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic color of the tooltip. With the `glass` variant the color only tints the border (neutral keeps the plain frosted surface)

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `solid` (filled; neutral is the inverted contrasting surface), `subtle` (tinted surface with a border) or `glass` (frosted elevated surface)

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of the tooltip

props.name: animation
props.description: Show / hide animation

props.name: enterDelay
props.description: Delay before showing on hover, in milliseconds

props.name: leaveDelay
props.description: Delay before hiding on mouse leave, in milliseconds

props.name: offset
props.description: Offset as [x, y] in pixels. For top/bottom placements `y` is the gap to the trigger and `x` shifts along it; for left/right placements `x` is the gap and `y` shifts along it. Without it the tooltip sits 8px away.

props.name: followCursor
props.description: Makes the tooltip follow the mouse cursor

props.name: zIndex
props.description: z-index of the tooltip

props.name: arrow
props.description: Shows an arrow pointing at the trigger

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the tooltip

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label of the tooltip element

props.name: asChild
props.description: Attaches the hover / focus handlers, the ref and `className` directly to the single child element instead of wrapping it in a `<div>` (keeps flex and grid layouts intact). The child must accept a `ref`.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Additional class name of the tooltip (floating) element. To customize the colors, set the `--tooltip-bg` (background, gradients allowed) and `--tooltip-color` (text) custom properties on it

props.name: contentRef
props.description: Ref to the tooltip (floating) element, set while it is shown

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Called with the requested open state (hover, focus, Escape, ref methods)

events.name: onOpen
events.description: Called when the tooltip opens from hover or focus

events.name: onClose
events.description: Called when the tooltip closes from mouse leave, blur or Escape

props.name: enterDelay
props.description: Default delay before showing on hover, in milliseconds, for every Tooltip inside that does not set `enterDelay`

props.name: leaveDelay
props.description: Default delay before hiding on mouse leave, in milliseconds, for every Tooltip inside that does not set `leaveDelay`

props.name: skipDelay
props.description: When another tooltip of the provider closed less than this many milliseconds ago, the next one opens without waiting for its enter delay

examples.title: asChild
examples.description: asChild attaches the tooltip to the child itself, without a wrapper element, so flex and grid layouts stay intact. contentClassName styles the tooltip.

examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Wrap a focusable element. The tooltip shows on hover and on keyboard focus, and Escape closes it, even when it was opened by hover.

examples.title: Colors
examples.description: color picks the semantic color: neutral (default), info, success, warning or danger.

examples.title: Controlled and imperative
examples.description: Control visibility with open and onOpenChange (hover, focus and Escape still request changes), or call open / close / toggle on a TooltipRef.

examples.title: Custom colors, arrow and offset
examples.description: Set the --tooltip-bg (solid colors and CSS gradients) and --tooltip-color custom properties on the tooltip through contentClassName; arrow adds a pointer to the trigger; offset sets the gap to the trigger (8px by default).

examples.title: Delays and disabled
examples.description: enterDelay and leaveDelay control the hover timing; disabled turns the tooltip off.

examples.title: Events
examples.description: onOpen and onClose fire on hover, focus, blur and Escape.

examples.title: Follow cursor
examples.description: With followCursor the tooltip tracks the mouse pointer.

examples.title: TooltipProvider
examples.description: A TooltipProvider sets default delays for the tooltips inside; moving quickly from one tooltip to the next opens it immediately.

examples.title: Shapes
examples.description: Default, rounded, square and thought-bubble shapes.

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: variant picks the style: solid (default; filled, the neutral one is an inverted surface that contrasts with the theme), subtle (tinted surface with a border) or glass (frosted surface that follows the theme; the color tints its border).

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Wrap a focusable trigger: the content attribute is shown on hover and focus. placement accepts 12 positions, arrow adds an arrow and disabled turns the tooltip off.

styles.title: Colors, variants, shapes and animations
styles.description: color sets the semantic tone, variant the surface (solid, subtle, glass), shape the outline and animation the enter / exit transition.

provider.title: Provider and rich content
provider.description: <minerva-tooltip-provider> gives the tooltips inside shared delays; moving to the next tooltip within skip-delay opens it at once. The content slot holds markup.

controlled.title: Methods, events and follow cursor
controlled.description: show(), hide() and toggle() drive a tooltip directly (without firing events); hover and focus fire the cancelable minerva-open-change. follow-cursor tracks the pointer, offset sets the gap.

events.minerva-open-change: Hover, focus, blur, pointer leave or Escape asked to open / close (detail: { open }); cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current state.

slots.default: The trigger; prefer a single focusable element (button, link...).
slots.content: Rich tooltip content (alternative to the content attribute).

methods.show: Shows the tooltip (does not fire minerva-open-change).
methods.hide: Hides the tooltip (does not fire minerva-open-change).
methods.toggle: Toggles the tooltip (does not fire minerva-open-change).
